func save_game(slot_index: int, chapter_title: String, game_state_data: Dictionary, save_ui: CanvasItem = null) -> bool:

		int(time_dict["year"]),
		int(time_dict["hour"]),
		int(time_dict["minute"])
	]

		"state": game_state_data

	var json_path := get_slot_json_path(slot_index)
	var file := FileAccess.open(json_path, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if not file:
		printerr("Impossibile aprire il file di salvataggio per la scrittura.")
		return false
	
	file.store_string(json_string)
	return true

func _ready() -> void:
	if confirm_dialog:
		confirm_dialog.confirmed.connect(_on_confirm_dialog_confirmed)
	_refresh_slots()


func _refresh_slots() -> void:
	if not slot_container:
		return
	
	for slot_idx in range(1, SaveManager.TOTAL_SLOTS + 1):
		_update_slot_ui(slot_idx)


func _update_slot_ui(slot_idx: int) -> void:
	var json_path := SaveManager.get_slot_json_path(slot_idx)
	var image_path := SaveManager.get_slot_image_path(slot_idx)
	var slot_node := slot_container.get_node_or_null("Slot_%02d" % slot_idx)
	if not slot_node:
		return
	
	var thumbnail_rect: TextureRect = slot_node.get_node_or_null("Thumbnail") as TextureRect
	var chapter_label: Label = slot_node.get_node_or_null("ChapterLabel") as Label
	var date_label: Label = slot_node.get_node_or_null("DateLabel") as Label
	
	if FileAccess.file_exists(json_path):
		var file := FileAccess.open(json_path, FileAccess.READ)
		if file:
			var content := file.get_as_text()
			var data: Variant = JSON.parse_string(content)
			if data is Dictionary:
				if chapter_label:
					chapter_label.text = String(data.get("chapter_title", "Senza Titolo"))
				if date_label:
					date_label.text = String(data.get("timestamp", ""))
		
		if FileAccess.file_exists(image_path) and thumbnail_rect:
			var img := Image.load_from_file(image_path)
			if img:
				thumbnail_rect.texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
	else:
		if chapter_label:
			chapter_label.text = "Vuoto"
		if date_label:
			date_label.text = ""
		if thumbnail_rect:
			thumbnail_rect.texture = null


func request_delete_slot(slot_idx: int) -> void:
	_selected_slot = slot_idx
	_pending_action = "delete"
	if confirm_dialog:
		confirm_dialog.dialog_text = "Vuoi davvero eliminare il salvataggio nello Slot %d?" % slot_idx
		confirm_dialog.popup_centered()


func _on_confirm_dialog_confirmed() -> void:
	if _selected_slot <= 0:
		return
	
	if _pending_action == "delete":
		var json_path := SaveManager.get_slot_json_path(_selected_slot)
		var image_path := SaveManager.get_slot_image_path(_selected_slot)
		if FileAccess.file_exists(json_path):
			DirAccess.remove_absolute(json_path)
		if FileAccess.file_exists(image_path):
			DirAccess.remove_absolute(image_path)
		_refresh_slots()
	
	_selected_slot = -1
	_pending_action = ""
